name: Osotspa Public Company Limited
summary: Osotspa Public Company Limited, along with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes energy drinks and personal care products in Thailand and internationally. It operates through three segments: Beverage, Personal Care, and Others. The company offers energy and sport drinks under the M-150, Lipo, Som in Sum, M-Sport, Shark, and White Shark brands; and functional drinks under the C-Vitt, Peptein, Calpis Lacto, One Day Vitamins, and HANGster brands. It also provides baby care products, including baby wash, powder, soap, lotion, oil, shampoo, laundry detergent, and fabric softener, as well as gift sets, dish soap, feminine cleansing, hand foam, hand sanitizer, surface and product cleanser,…
